data.name: Pratik
data.gender_notes: Pratik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who reaches, attains or touches. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pras' meaning to reach, touch and 'ruti' meaning the rule or path. The name Pratik carries the meaning “Reach, Attain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pratik usually hope their child will grow to embody reach, attain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the spiritual journey and the determination to reach the ultimate truth.
data.etymology: Pratik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reach, Attain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pratik total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
